## Before you apply

A limited-time API credits program by WisGate for high-quality builders using AI in real products and workflows. Approved companies can be reviewed for up to $2,000 in WisGate API Credits. WisGate is an All-In-One AI API with OpenAI-compatible access across LLM, image, coding, and automation workflows. The program is manually reviewed so credits go to teams that actually build and use APIs.

The pilot window runs from May 26, 2026 to June 26, 2026, UTC+0. It is intended for startups, AI product builders, developer teams, automation teams, and individual builders with real AI products or production-oriented AI workflows. The program may end early if the pilot allocation is filled.

Click Apply for API Credits and submit the form. Review usually takes around 7 business days. If approved, you will receive an email. Sign in or register with WisGate using the same email you submitted so credits can be issued to the correct account.

Approved companies can be reviewed for up to $2,000 in total credits. Credits are not cash, are not transferable, and are intended for eligible WisGate API usage. Exact credit details are confirmed upon approval and delivery.
